payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_session.py::test_the_generic_stub_answers_spec_ids_without_a_real_grep_call stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/cell/session.py. The claim was '`_stub_the_runtime` (tests/test_session.py:1180) stubs `saffron.cell.worktree.dirty_paths` to an empty-list lambda right beside its other worktree stubs (tests/test_session.py:1379), but stubs no such thing for the sibling `saffron.cell.worktree.spec_ids` that `GateSuite._run` also reads off every `Tree` it is handed (saffron/gates/suite.py). Left unstubbed, a call to `spec_ids` falls through to the fixture\'s own catch-all `saffron.cell.runtime.exec_` double (tests/test_session.py:1281), which logs the real `git grep` argv into `cell.execs` and returns it empty. Add `monkeypatch.setattr("saffron.cell.worktree.spec_ids", lambda container: [])` immediately after the `dirty_paths` line, the same shape as its sibling. The witness drives one ordinary two-turn cell through `_stub_the_runtime` and `_drive`, reaching `READY_FOR_REVIEW`, where `GateSuite.baseline` and `GateSuite.against` both read `tree.spec_ids()` on the implementer cell (`saffron-cell-SY-1`). It asserts that no entry in `cell.execs` is the id-listing `git grep` argv, which only holds once the stub is in place.'. Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_events.py::test_watch_output_matches_the_golden_fixture, tests/test_session.py::test_a_container_the_export_removed_is_not_reported_surviving_teardown, tests/test_session.py::test_a_first_call_the_provider_never_served_reports_the_proxy_and_the_cell_before_teardown, tests/test_session.py::test_a_read_that_fails_is_reported_and_masks_neither_the_outcome_nor_teardown, tests/test_session.py::test_every_lens_runs_in_a_container_the_implementer_never_ran_in, tests/test_session.py::test_the_critic_cell_is_not_on_the_implementers_network, tests/test_session.py::test_no_cell_a_task_brings_up_is_granted_a_capability, tests/test_session.py::test_a_base_with_no_saffron_dir_never_reaches_the_image_build, tests/test_session.py::test_a_cell_run_produces_a_witness_result, tests/test_session.py::test_a_cell_run_supplies_the_real_mutator, tests/test_session.py::test_a_skipped_witness_blocks_nothing_at_either_tier, tests/test_sigterm.py::test_a_cell_sent_sigterm_tears_down_and_closes_its_task, tests/test_sigterm.py::test_a_second_sigterm_does_not_cut_the_teardown_short, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
